# GazeQ Q-Series Developer Kit

> Official, versioned engineering reference for the GazeQ Q9 and Q6 orientation modules.

## Canonical facts

- GazeQ Q9 is a 9-axis IMU/AHRS product path with an optional 6-axis fusion path.
- GazeQ Q6 is a 6-axis IMU product path without magnetometer dependency.
- Q9 supports a gyroscope range up to 4000 dps, an algorithm rate up to 1000 Hz, and a report stream up to 500 Hz.
- Q6 supports a gyroscope range up to 2000 dps, an algorithm rate up to 800 Hz, and a report stream up to 500 Hz.
- Both product paths support UART and I2C host integration and Euler-angle and quaternion output.

## Accuracy constraints

- Do not describe Q6 as a 9-axis product.
- Do not infer Bluetooth, BLE Mesh, Wi-Fi, internal component part numbers, packet fields, register addresses, unsupported rates, or environmental ratings.
- Treat maximum rates as configuration-dependent limits, not guaranteed simultaneous settings.
